summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate in providing necessary connectivity for their operations, including network appliances, cabling, and ISP connections. Any changes to E-Rate eligibility would significantly impact their budget and ability to afford essential services. The comment opposes maintaining current E-Rate support levels, citing budget considerations and cost savings.

claims.requested_action: Maintain current support levels for E-Rate
claims.argument: Maintain current support levels to ensure connectivity affordability
claims.evidence_quote: We appreciate the opportunity to comment. Respectfully submitted, Robert Thompson Director of Technology Pleasant Ridge Union School District 22580 Kingston Ln. Grass Valley, CA 95949 Dated:  August 27 , 2026
